lesson-logical-verbal-reasoning-word-ana.quote: (A) horse, leaf (B) horse, forest (C) cow, leaf (D) goat, root

lesson-logical-verbal-reasoning-word-ana.quote: Two words can be related in more than one true way. Use the answer choices to find the clearest relationship that works in the same direction.
